metadata.description: Molt agents marketplace: one Claude plugin per sold agent, installable from Claude Code, the Claude desktop app and claude.ai.

plugins.name: cerebro-operativo
plugins.description: Operating brain for an organization on Google Drive: playbooks and a decision log kept current from recorded meetings, answers to "how do we handle this" with sources, drafts in the company's voice, a daily routine and a weekly audit.

plugins.name: codificador-sesiones
plugins.description: Qualitative session coder for a research team on Google Drive: interviews and focus groups coded by participant and variable with the verbatim quote and minute, in the team's own format and calibrated on a study they coded by hand; emergent categories proposed with evidence; variables crossed step by step with a pause for the researcher.

plugins.name: directorio-freelancers
plugins.description: Production freelancer directory for a production company or agency on Google Drive: one card per freelancer (specialties, assignment limits, certifications with expiry, dated reliability facts, channel and language), availability requests drafted per person in priority order with the answers logged, and a weekly sweep of certifications about to expire. It never writes to the freelancers, books or pays anyone, or rates a person on its own.
